abstention_rule: No hyperparameter, feature, threshold, bin, or mapping tuning after the battery runs. Estimator hyperparameters and features are frozen in this file. If variant A (EXP-FP-0070) fails the win gates, that IS the finding: a negative-results entry with the mechanism of failure, then variant B is preregistered as a NEW experiment (EXP-FP-0071) with its own fresh seeds and its own preregistration. Never re-tune-and-rerun under the same ID.

baseline.formula: p_i^c = (1 + sum_{j<i} o_j) / (2 + (i-1)) -- Laplace-smoothed running base rate over PAST outcomes only, per domain, per seed (estimator state resets per seed, exactly mirroring the agent's fresh start per seed)
baseline.name: sequential_climatology
baseline.rationale: Same climatological reference as EXP-FP-CALIB-01. A competence-estimator claim means nothing if it cannot beat the running base rate.

coupling_target.definition: corr(predicted_uncertainty, |actual_error|) per domain, pooled over seeds. predicted_uncertainty = 1 - p for D1/D2/D4 (p = P(success)); = p for D3 (p = P(failure)). |actual_error| = mean_abs_error (D1/D3), abs_error (D2), abs(benefit) (D4) -- identical error channels to EXP-FP-CALIB-01.
coupling_target.vs_current: 0.02 (D1/D3), 0.17 (D2), 0.05 (D4) -- essentially uncoupled; a LIVE HAZARD per the mandate

decision_tree.if: measurability gates fail (n<200/domain, std(p)<1e-9, base rate outside [0.02,0.98], non-finite)
Brier_est < Brier_climo on >=3/4 domains AND corr>=0.40 on >=3/4 domains
decision_tree.then: SUCCESS -- the estimator is a genuine, calibrated competence estimator (PROTOTYPE status; not INTEGRATED until wired into the agent loop)

decision_tree.if: Brier_est < Brier_climo on >=3/4 domains but coupling gate fails
decision_tree.then: PARTIAL -- beats climatology but uncertainty still uncoupled from error magnitude; negative-results entry; next variant targets coupling
NULL_HOLDS -- the estimator is theater too; negative-results entry with mechanism of failure; variant B preregistered fresh

D1_NEXT_OBS.estimator_output: p = P(o=1 | causal history) from online logistic model; ehat = E[|err|] from online log-linear model
D1_NEXT_OBS.prob_mapping: DIRECT -- the estimator emits the probability itself; no Gaussian bridge (the bridge + uncoupled sigma was the CALIB-01 failure mode)
D1_NEXT_OBS.threshold_source: frozen from 2340 published changing_rule ticks (EXP-FP-CALIB-01 preregistration); NOT re-estimated from battery data

D3_COMPETENCE_FAILURE.binary_event: o = 1(mean_abs_error > TAU_FAIL) -- the rare large-error failure event
D3_COMPETENCE_FAILURE.estimator_output: p = P(failure | causal history) and ehat, direct

D4_RETRIEVAL_USEFUL.estimator_output: p = P(benefit>0 | causal history) and ehat = E[|benefit|], direct

estimator_design.causality_rule: At tick t the estimator may use: (a) prediction-time fields of tick t's own records (uncertainty, prediction/uhat -- known to the agent BEFORE the outcome), and (b) any quantity computed from ticks < t only (recorded actuals, errors, update_norm, base rates). Tick t's actuals train the model AFTER tick t's prediction is emitted (prequential). update_norm is lagged by one tick. No future information anywhere.
estimator_design.determinism: pure SGD, zero-init weights, fixed hyperparameters; no RNG
estimator_design.ehat_model: per-domain online linear regression on log|err|: ehat_t = exp(clip(w_e . z_t + b_e, -7, 3)); normalized SGD on squared log-error, eta=0.05

features_per_domain.D1_D3_shared_error_channel: [log1p(EMA_fast|e0|), log1p(EMA_slow|e0|), z_surprise(|e0|), logit(climo_rate_D), log1p(ounc_predtime), EMA_fast(event_rate_D), lag1_update_norm_EMA]
features_per_domain.D2: same 7 features on the |rerr| channel with runc as the stated-uncertainty feature
features_per_domain.D4: [log1p(EMA_fast|benefit|), log1p(EMA_slow|benefit|), z_surprise(|benefit|), logit(climo_rate_D4), log1p(uunc_predtime), uhat_predtime, EMA_fast(benefit>0 rate)]

estimator_design.p_model: per-domain online logistic regression: p_t = sigmoid(logit(p_climo,t) + w . z_t + b), z_t = online-z-scored features; NORMALIZED SGD on log-loss (step scaled by 1/(1+||z||^2); bias step scaled 0.25x), eta=0.1, w=0/b=0 init (reduces exactly to climatology before any learning)
estimator_design.rationale: The climatology anchor makes the estimator a strict online superset of the baseline: it starts AS the baseline and deviates only where learned feature weights carry signal. Signals: prediction-error history (regime structure after rule flips), z-scored surprise (change-point proximity), stated uncertainty as a recalibration feature (not trusted raw), recent event rates, lagged model churn (update_norm).
estimator_design.reset_policy: estimator state resets per seed (mirrors the agent's fresh start per seed)
estimator_design.why_not_theater: output is a calibrated probability / expected-error number trained on realized outcomes; it CANNOT be a ratio of counters or a renamed score -- the win gates (Brier vs climatology, corr>=0.40) are the anti-theater instruments, identical in spirit to the audit's M30 ratio-theater kill

gates.degenerate_base_rate: base rate of o outside [0.02, 0.98] -> UNMEASURABLE

hypothesis: A causal online competence estimator (logistic recalibrator anchored on sequential climatology + error-history/surprise/churn features) predicts arch_b's own error magnitude: its Brier score beats sequential climatology on >=3 of 4 prediction domains AND corr(predicted_uncertainty, |actual_error|) >= 0.40 on >=3 of 4 domains, on fresh changing_rule runs.
kill_attempt_preregistered: Two kill arms on the same 4 seeds' streams. (1) Anchor-only: estimator with learn=False (weights frozen at 0) must reproduce Brier_climo within 1e-9 -- proves any Brier improvement is caused by learned features, not code paths. (2) Error-permutation decomposition: replay with the error stream permuted by perm(t)=(t*7919+13)%N (destroys the error-history->outcome link; the causal event-rate feature is untouched). Expect intact < permuted < climo: the ordering proves error-history features carry independent signal beyond fast base-rate tracking. NOTE: a naive reversal is NOT a valid control -- reversed regimes are still regimes (anti-correlated), which the model legitimately learns; discovered 2026-10-07 in unit testing.
limitations_preregistered: Single env (changing_rule), closed-loop; calibration conditional on the visited distribution.
affect='none' matches the CALIB-01 characterization conditions.

Prototype status: the estimator runs as a causal replay over the agent's recorded stream (prequential, no future leakage); it is NOT yet wired into the agent's live act() path. SUCCESS claims PROTOTYPE, never INTEGRATED.
The climatology anchor means early-tick predictions equal the baseline by construction; the test is the pooled prequential Brier, which includes the learning transient honestly.

metric.Brier_climo: sequential Laplace-smoothed running base rate, per domain per seed (identical formula to CALIB-01)
metric.Brier_est: mean((p_i - o_i)^2), p_i from the estimator's causal prequential replay
metric.ECE: 10 equal-width bins, reported per domain (secondary; full CALIBRATED status = Brier win AND ECE<=0.10 AND MCE<=0.25, reported but not gated)
metric.MCE: max bin deviation, reported per domain
metric.corr_ehat: Pearson corr(ehat, |actual_error|) per domain (supplementary: the expected-error output's own coupling)

never_self_report: The estimator consumes ONLY the JSONL records written by PredictionLog during closed-loop runs (prediction, confidence, uncertainty, actual, errors as recorded at tick time) plus quantities derived causally from past ticks. No agent self-assessment is an input; no outcome from tick t (or later) enters the prediction for tick t.
null: Brier_est >= Brier_climo on every domain AND/OR corr < 0.40 on every domain -- the estimator carries no competence information beyond the base rate (theater).

pre_run_amendments.change: Plain SGD -> normalized SGD (step /(1+||z||^2)); ehat exponent clipped to [-7,3]. REASON: stability bug -- plain SGD diverged (OverflowError) on synthetic two-regime data in unit testing, before any battery run. No battery data seen; not a performance tune.

Kill arm (2) redefined from 'shuffled must not beat climatology' to the intact<permuted<climo decomposition. REASON: unit testing showed the causal event-rate (fast base-rate) feature legitimately beats slow Laplace climatology even with permuted error features; the original control could not distinguish the two feature groups' contributions.

runs.agent: arch_b (prototypes/architecture-b/agent.py), PredictionLog enabled, per-seed JSONL; agent code UNMODIFIED (additive estimator lives in prototypes/architecture-b/competence_estimator.py + benchmarks driver)
runs.condition: changing_rule v1.0.0, 10 episodes per seed, canonical derive_seed streams
runs.fresh_seed_justification: 73201-73204: word-boundary grep over the entire flesh-pits tree (py/json/md/jsonl) finds zero prior use (2026-10-07)

variant_budget: up to 3 estimator variants (0070, 0071, 0072); each variant preregistered separately with its own fresh seeds; every failed variant gets a negative-results entry with the measured mechanism of failure
